title: Call cost annotation schema (scratchbook)
content:
Context / motivation:
- Product asks for clearer per-call attribution so downstream teams (GTM, finance, SRE) can reason about cost anomalies without pulling raw token streams.
- Need lightweight annotation that travels with a request through SDK -> ingress -> runtime -> billing pipeline and can be sampled for telemetry.
- Must avoid exposing user PII or model internals; should be mostly numeric/enum labels and short stable ids.

Goals (non-goals):
- Goal: produce a minimal schema that: (a) ties a request to cost buckets (model, length, special ops), (b) surfaces optional per-token breakdown pointers when needed, (c) is pluggable into existing request envelope as headers + body field.
- Non-goal: full token-level logging by default (privacy & cost). We'll provide pointers/URIs for on-demand fetch.

Constraints:
- Keep annotation size < 2KB for default pathing.
- Must be readable by downstream routers that are language-agnostic (JSON + HTTP headers).
- Support both synchronous generation and streaming responses.
- Work with Dedicated/Private where local billing connectors exist (so schema should be inert if not consumed).

High-level shape (v0.2) - stringified JSON inserted into X-RW-Cost-Annotation header + optional body field "cost_annotation":
- fields: (all keys snake_case)
  - annotation_version: string (eg "0.2")
  - model_id: string (catalog id, stable)
  - variant_hint: string (optional, short tag like "q4_0", "int8")
  - token_estimate: integer (client-provided guess if available)
  - client_quota_bucket: string (optional, e.g., "free-trial", "team-A-committed")
  - operation_flags: list of strings (optional; allowed values: ["embedding", "chat", "tool_call", "rerank", "streaming"]) 
  - cost_breakdown: string (one of: "summary", "pointer", "none")
  - breakdown_pointer: string (optional URL/URN for on-demand detailed breakdown)
  - sampling_hint: string (optional; one of ["always", "random/0.1", "min_latency", "billing-only"]) 
  - privacy_level: string (one of ["redact_sensitive", "redact_none"]) 
  - developer_labels: list of short strings (optional freeform tags, vetted length < 5)
  - request_id_hint: string (optional, client request id)

Example header (compact):
X-RW-Cost-Annotation: {\"annotation_version\":\"0.2\",\"model_id\":\"rw/gptx-8b\",\"variant_hint\":\"q4_1\",\"token_estimate\":120,\"operation_flags\":[\"chat\"],\"cost_breakdown\":\"pointer\",\"breakdown_pointer\":\"urn:rw:breakdown:us-west:20260220:abc123\",\"sampling_hint\":\"random/0.05\",\"privacy_level\":\"redact_sensitive\",\"developer_labels\":[\"onboarding-sample\"]}

When cost_breakdown == "summary": the runtime will include in response-metadata (or telemetry) a small summary object like:
  { total_tokens: 120, prompt_tokens: 40, gen_tokens: 80, estimated_unit_cost_usd: 0.004 }
This summary must be small and numeric only.

When cost_breakdown == "pointer": runtime stores detailed token-level attribution in internal blob store and returns a stable URN in breakdown_pointer. The blob should be accessible only by authorized billing/triage services and expire after TTL (default 7 days).

SDK mapping notes:
- JS/TS: SDK attaches header automatically when user passes `costAnnotation` option to call. Provide a helper builder (CostAnnotation.builder()) that validates shapes and enforces label limits.
- Python: same pattern via optional kwarg `cost_annotation=`.
- If client provides both header and body field, prefer header.

Telemetry & sampling:
- Router should respect sampling_hint when possible but can override for system reasons. Sampling_hint is a signal, not a mandate.
- Default sampling policy: sample summaries at 0.5% for free tier, 5% for paid; sample pointer-storage at 0.1% across the board (store cost is non-trivial).
- For anomalies (slo breach or cost spike), SRE can trigger higher sampling via special control-plane flag.

Privacy and security considerations:
- Developer labels must be sanitized; they are seen in billing UI. Max 5 labels, each <= 32 chars. Reject non-UTF-8.
- breakdown_pointer URNs must not embed user PII; blobs must be encrypted and access-logged.
- privacy_level == redact_sensitive requires runtime to apply our existing PII redaction heuristics before generating detailed breakdowns. The runtime will still store raw blobs if allowed by tenancy, but access restricted.

Billing mapping (how finance maps to per-token units):
- The annotation gives model_id + variant_hint; billing pipeline will resolve model-specific unit price table and apply token counts from summary or blob. If only token_estimate present, mark as estimate and fall back to measured tokens during billing reconciliation.
- For special ops (rerank, embeddings), use operation_flags to route to appropriate cost calculators.

Edge cases / failure modes:
- Malformed header: ignore annotation and tag telemetry with "annotation:malformed".
- breakdown_pointer unreachable: tag request as "breakdown:missing" and route to summary fallback or mark for rehydration job.
- Large annotation (>2KB): reject with 400 at ingress (configurable).

Compatibility with Dedicated/Private:
- Schema intentionally opt-in; if a private deployment does not wire breakdown storage, runtime should return cost_breakdown: "none" and still accept header without error.

Open questions / tradeoffs:
- Should we version as 0.1, 0.2 etc, or use semantic fields and deprecate? (I prefer explicit version field to allow server-side toggles).
- Do we allow anonymized per-token histograms in the summary (e.g., buckets of token-cost)? That increases usefulness but also leak risk.
- How do we surface developer_labels in billing UI without clutter? Maybe label whitelist or mapping to business tags.
- TTL for breakdown_pointer blobs: 7d vs 30d? 7d default, allow enterprise overrides.

Next steps (short):
- Draft small JSON Schema for v0.2 and add to GH PR template (owners: @evan-m).
- Add helpers to JS/TS & Py SDKs to produce header safely (owners: Lina).
- Wire a lightweight router flag to honor sampling_hint (SRE work).
- Prototype breakdown_pointer store + quick ACL model (SRE + infra).

Notes to self (TODO):
- Check overlaps with billing-internal:unitization spec (finance) — ask @Kai.
- Try a quick experiment by sampling 0.5% with pointers for a week to estimate storage cost.
- Keep default privacy_level conservative (redact_sensitive) until compliance signs off.

Rough JSON Schema (human readable, not strict):
{\n  \"type\": \"object\",\n  \"properties\": {\n    \"annotation_version\": {\"type\":\"string\"},\n    \"model_id\": {\"type\":\"string\"},\n    \"variant_hint\": {\"type\":\"string\"},\n    \"token_estimate\": {\"type\":\"integer\"},\n    \"operation_flags\": {\"type\":\"array\",\"items\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\n    \"cost_breakdown\": {\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"summary\",\"pointer\",\"none\"]},\n    \"breakdown_pointer\": {\"type\":\"string\"},\n    \"sampling_hint\": {\"type\":\"string\"},\n    \"privacy_level\": {\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"redact_sensitive\",\"redact_none\"]},\n    \"developer_labels\": {\"type\":\"array\",\"items\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\n    \"request_id_hint\": {\"type\":\"string\"}\n  }\n}\n
Signature: file-level: stash this, iterate in GH. Keep minimal and pragmatic for first rollouts.

-- Aisha
